title: Blue Water Pontoon Boat Rental
specs: Fleet boats are generally 3 to 4 years old or newer
Operating hours 9:00 AM to 1 hour before sunset daily if weather permits
Driver must have prior boating experience
Drivers born after Jan 1, 1988 must hold a free Boater Safety Certificate from MyFWC
Renters must be 23 years of age to rent
includes: Fuel is provided but not included; charged for amount used
gap: Maximum number of passengers per boat not stated
blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats for 4, 6, or 8 hours to enjoy activities like birthdays, special celebrations, bachelor/bachelorette parties, sunrise or sunset views, and fishing trips. Boats are launched from Bellair Boat Ramp and are generally 3 to 4 years old or newer. Renters must have prior boating experience and meet age and licensing requirements.
extraNote: $100 reservation deposit applies, goes towards rental price · $250 security deposit required, returned if no damages · Fuel charge deducted from security deposit · 72-hour cancellation notice required to avoid $100 fee · No-call/no-shows charged full reservation rate · No cancellation fee if bad weather (Small Craft Advisory, Marine Hazard Statement, Limited Visibility) · Guests must return at least one hour before sunset · Late arrival cuts into rental time · Bellair Boat Ramp, 3900 W Bay Dr., Belleair Bluffs, FL 33770
